gaps: The CSM Procol employee branch cannot be represented because no CSM Procol employee actor is available.

the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The user in neither category is approximated by the available vendor actor; the available vocabulary does not provide an explicit unauthorized-user actor.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Renamed_…”.
The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Vendor_Update_…”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “title” equals the title sent in step 1.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “title” equals the title sent in step 1.
